title: Annual Estimates of the Resident Population for Incorporated Places and Counties in Florida: April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025 (Vintage 2025, SUB-EST2025)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
measures: Estimates base April 2020 and July 1 estimates 2020–2025 for St. Petersburg, West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Sarasota and Tampa cities and Pinellas, Palm Beach, Sarasota and Manatee counties. Percentage changes computed by the editorial team.
limitations: Model-based estimates revised each vintage; not a count of patients; do not explain causes of change.

title: National Hurricane Center Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Helene (AL092024)
geography: Florida Gulf coast incl. Pinellas, Manatee and Sarasota counties
measures: Storm surge, fatalities and structural damage reported in Pinellas, Hillsborough, Manatee and Sarasota counties, September 2024.
limitations: Damage figures compiled from media and emergency managers; describes one storm, not future risk.

title: National Hurricane Center Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Milton (AL142024)
geography: Florida west coast, Sarasota and Tampa Bay areas
measures: Landfall on Siesta Key on 10 October 2024 as a category 3 hurricane; major damage in the Sarasota and Tampa Bay areas; area previously affected by Helene two weeks earlier.
limitations: Report notes damage assessments were complicated by the earlier storm.
